details: Animation runs in a single RAF loop with no D3 transitions, so handoff races are handled gracefully by capturing animT as the new animFrom on button click; the pointermove handler does an un-throttled O(5000) linear scan per mouse event but operates entirely on a Float32Array with no DOM mutations or redraws, keeping it below the update-storm threshold. Pointer Events API unifies mouse/touch, and there are no cross-view dispatchers or captured scale closures.
